The Al0HfNbTiZr HEA with excellent plasticity consists of a single random body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solution phase.
The Al-free HEA consists of a single random BCC solid solution phase with lattice constant of 3.437 Å.
As Al content gradually increases from x = 0.5 to 1.5, the peak positions of all BCC crystal planes shift towards high diffraction angle, indicating the reduction of lattice constant.
When Al content is increased to x = 0.75, ordered BCC solid solution phase appears and the minor (100) diffraction peak can be found at 25.9 ºaccordingly as a result of structural ordering.

Al content in interdendrites is a bit higher than that of dendrites for each HEA, suggesting that ordered BCC phase is mainly distributed in interdendrite region and the random one is mainly concentrated in the dendrites.

When Al content is beyond the boundary, ordered BCC phase starts to be presented in the random BCC matrix.

Further increasing the content of Al from x = 0.75 to 1.5 results in the elevated peak intensity of (100) diffraction planes and appearance of other characteristic ordered diffraction peaks of (111), (210) and (221), indicating the volume expansion of ordered BCC solid solution.

attributes.morphology: coarse primary dendrites with a few short secondary dendrites

evidence.quote: Al-free HEA consists of a larger number of coarse primary dendrites with 900 ~1400 µm in length and a few short secondary dendrites

attributes.morphology: different orientations, with many secondary dendrites nearly perpendicular to primary dendrites

evidence.quote: For x=0.5, the primary dendrites exhibit different orientations and truncated length of about 500~700 µm. In addition, a large number of secondary dendrites appear and are nearly perpendicular to primary dendrites, exhibiting the optimal cooling direction.

attributes.morphology: refined crystal size with close crystal-axis spacing and blurred boundaries after etching

evidence.quote: For x=0.75, the spacing of each crystal axis is close to each other and crystal size becomes more refined. Moreover, the blurred boundaries exist after etching.

attributes.morphology: slightly refined dendrites with visibly widened primary dendrites

evidence.quote: Dendrites of Al1.0 HEA are slightly refined, while the primary dendrites are visibly widened.
When Al content is increased to x=1.25 and 1.5, the dendrites are refined to 200~350 µm and show snowflakes-like morphology.
